name: mission-control
description: A pane beside the chat with your monitoring alarms, merge requests and CI, tasks due, and today's calendar.

prtgServer.title: PRTG MCP server
prtgServer.description: Name of an MCP server with a prtg_get_alarms tool, as /mcp lists it. Empty hides Monitoring.

gitlabHost.title: GitLab host
gitlabHost.description: GitLab host that glab is signed in to, such as gitlab.com. Empty hides Merge requests.

planeUrl.title: Plane web address
planeUrl.description: Base address of your Plane instance, used for item links, such as https://app.plane.so.

planeServers.title: Plane MCP servers
planeServers.description: Comma-separated MCP server names, one per Plane workspace. Empty hides Plane.

calendarServer.title: Google Calendar MCP server
calendarServer.description: Name of a Google Calendar MCP server with a list_events tool. Empty hides Today.
